items.title: Cilium 1.20 扩展了 Gateway API 并为 Kubernetes 开放了 eBPF 数据路径
items.summary_zh: Cilium 1.20 发布，Gateway API 从 1.4 升到 1.6，新增 ExternalAuth、ListenerSets、CORS 过滤与 TCPRoute、UDPRoute，把 HTTP 鉴权和数据库、DNS 等非 HTTP 流量收进同一套 Kubernetes API；同时开放可扩展 eBPF 数据路径并推进无 sidecar 双向 TLS。ListenerSets 让应用团队自建监听器，平台团队保留共享网关控制权。
items.summary_en: Cilium 1.20 is out, moving Gateway API support from 1.4 to 1.6 with ExternalAuth, ListenerSets, CORS filtering, and TCPRoute/UDPRoute, bringing HTTP authorization and non-HTTP traffic such as databases and DNS under the same Kubernetes API. The release also exposes an extensible eBPF data path and advances sidecar-free mutual TLS; ListenerSets let app teams add listeners in their own namespaces while platform teams keep control of shared gateways.

items.title: 微软推出 dotnetup：多版本管理更省心，安装方式却让开发者皱眉
items.summary_zh: 微软发布 dotnetup 公开预览版，这个借鉴 rustup 与 nvm 的跨平台工具链管理器把 .NET SDK 和运行时装进用户账户目录，而不是 Program Files\dotnet 或 /usr/share/dotnet。它按 latest、lts、preview 等通道或主次版本、功能带解析安装意图，并读取最近的 global.json 以保持团队构建一致。默认的 everywhere 模式会改写系统 PATH，优先级高于 Visual Studio 装的全机器版本，这正是安装方式引争议之处。
items.summary_en: Microsoft shipped a public preview of dotnetup, a cross-platform toolchain manager modeled on rustup and nvm that installs the .NET SDK and runtimes into the user's local data directory instead of Program Files\dotnet or /usr/share/dotnet. It resolves channels such as latest, lts or preview (or a major, minor or feature band) and reads the nearest global.json to keep builds deterministic. The default Windows-only everywhere mode rewrites system PATH and overrides machine-wide installs, including Visual Studio's, which is where the install experience draws complaints.

items.summary_en: Over a weekend the author adapted fluent-reader-lite, a five-year-old open-source Flutter RSS client built entirely with pre-iOS 26 Cupertino widgets, to the iPhone Duo form factor. Instead of following Apple's design guidelines, he borrowed a trick from WeChat Reading: rotating the status bar with preferredVerticalBarBehavior and placing it on the same row as the top navigation bar so the main UI fills the screen. The code is on GitHub for anyone curious about layout on wide or foldable screens.

items.title: Anthropic团队零Rust经验起步，靠Claude完成核心API跨语言重构：CPU省40%，延迟降20%
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 把一个原本没有 Rust 经验的团队组织起来，借助 Claude 将 Messages API 从 Python 重写为 Rust，人类工程师主要负责架构、迁移策略和验证方案。据平台工程负责人 Katelyn Lesse 介绍，改造后 CPU 消耗下降约 40%—50%，首 Token 延迟改善约 10%—20%。她随后在长文中提出，当大量 Agent 长时间自主运行、彼此协作时，Kubernetes 等现有基础设施在隔离、状态保存与调度上都需要新的工程方案。
items.summary_en: Anthropic migrated its Messages API from Python to Rust with a team that had no prior Rust experience, leaning on Claude to write most of the code while engineers handled architecture, migration strategy, and verification. Platform engineering lead Katelyn Lesse reports roughly 40-50% lower CPU usage and 10-20% better first-token latency. In a follow-up essay she argues that long-running, collaborating agents will demand new infrastructure work around Kubernetes isolation, state persistence, and scheduling, framing that as fresh territory for engineers rather than a threat.

items.title: 框架选不对，Claude 开发成本多一倍：前端十年框架膨胀，终于有人买单了
items.summary_zh: 前 Microsoft Edge 性能项目经理 Nolan Lawson 让 AI Agent 用 12 种 JavaScript 框架分别构建同一个 Pokémon 应用，统一使用 Claude Opus 5.5 和 High 推理强度，比拼开发成本、Token 消耗与产物性能。结果显示中位成本最低的 Hono+htmx 为 2.67 美元，Angular 达到 4.97 美元，Token 消耗 976 万对 426 万，差约 2.3 倍。
items.summary_en: Nolan Lawson, a former performance program manager on Microsoft Edge, had an AI agent build the same Pokémon app in 12 JavaScript frameworks, all with Claude Opus 5.5 at high reasoning effort, then compared cost, token use and output quality. Hono+htmx came in at a median $2.67 versus $4.97 for Angular, with token consumption of 4.26 million against 9.76 million, roughly 2.3 times higher, raising the question of whether framework choices made for human developer experience still hold when agents write the code.

items.summary_en: Felix Rieseberg, an Anthropic engineering manager who led work on Claude Cowork, argues in a blog post that people should be more ambitious with AI: instead of triaging crash reports himself and handing fixes to Claude, he now gives the model the raw data and tools to decide. He also describes "adversarial review", where several Claudes critique each other and another judges the critiques, and calls "you are an expert in X" prompts a 2024 habit. His team built Claude Cowork in about a week and a half.

items.summary_zh: TokenSpeed 是尚旭春在 AICon 2026 深圳站分享的 Agent 场景推理引擎：优化目标从“打满 batch”改为“每用户 TPS 不低于 70 的延迟约束下最大化单卡吞吐”，batch=1 时端到端延迟比 TensorRT-LLM 快 9%。分享还覆盖分层解耦架构、自动并行编译与 KV Cache 复用路线，面向为 coding agent 多轮短请求调优推理栈的工程师。
items.summary_en: TokenSpeed, presented by independent contributor Shang Xuchun at AICon 2026 Shenzhen, is an inference engine built for agentic workloads: rather than maximizing batch throughput, it targets the highest per-GPU throughput that still keeps each user above 70 TPS. On that basis it reports 9% lower end-to-end latency than TensorRT-LLM at batch size 1. The talk also covers a decoupled architecture, auto-parallel compilation and KV Cache reuse — useful for anyone tuning inference for multi-turn coding agents.

items.summary_en: claude-mem is a GitHub project that records everything an agent does during a session, compresses that history with AI, and injects the relevant parts back into later sessions so context carries over between runs. items.title: The 'Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen' post is misleading
items.author: syllogism
items.summary_zh: Hacker News 上的一则帖子指出，「Astra 能读写权重来改进 Qwen」的说法具有误导性：读取原始权重的那批实验，与真正修好 Qwen 的实验，用的是完全不同的技术手段。对关注权重编辑和模型改造的人，这是一条提醒——把两组实验并置，容易让人以为它们之间存在并不成立的因果关系。
items.summary_en: A Hacker News submission argues that the circulating claim "Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen" is misleading, because the experiments that read raw weights and the ones that actually fix Qwen use completely different techniques. It's a useful caution for anyone tracking weight-editing or model-surgery claims: placing two results side by side can imply a causal link that isn't there.

items.summary_zh: 作者连续抓包 72 小时，发现麦克风硬件采集唤醒次数为 0，没有拿到手机偷听的证据；真正造成“未卜先知”的，是公网 NAT 时空超图（ST-GNN）、现代隐私集合求交（PSI）和端侧微模型特征向量化。适合关心隐私边界和推荐系统原理的开发者阅读。

Useful for engineers who want to understand how targeting actually works and where the privacy line sits.

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.description: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.
items.author: JustVugg
items.summary_zh: colibri 是一个用纯 C 编写的 MoE 推理引擎，它按访问频率分层存放专家权重：热专家常驻 GPU（支持 CUDA 与 Vulkan），温专家留在内存，冷专家则从 NVMe 直接流式读取。由于每个 token 只用到数千亿参数模型中的一小部分专家，它能在你已有的硬件上跑起前沿开源 MoE 模型。
items.summary_en: colibri is a pure-C inference engine for large mixture-of-experts models that tiers expert weights by temperature: hot experts on the GPU via CUDA or Vulkan, warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Since each token touches only a fraction of a several-hundred-billion-parameter MoE, it can run frontier open models on hardware you already own.
